doc: The withholding list (Suvarna E5.2; plan 6.3; register R244; ROLE_SCRIBE 'the current withholding list'). A withheld (asset, criterion) is removed from the census before nikasha_fold.py --emit-gaps runs asset_census.emit_gaps_summary, so the gap ledger gets no transition for it in either direction (no OPEN, no RE-OPEN, no CLOSED credit). `entries` is an OBJECT keyed by gap id `<asset>-<criterion>` so the tracker's membership test (`entry in data['entries']`, detectors.py _withholding_has_entry, TRACK_E E4.2r deferred_withholding_entry) matches the string entry. This file is changed only by a reviewed PR on a recorded Strategic Suvarna decision or an accepted packet that shows the entry's condition holds; nikasha_fold.py never adds or lifts an entry.

bo_upaya-Idem.pattern.reason: bo_upaya's Idem.pattern PASS is unearned on every chart: commit fa9857f00 (#2607) removed the delete of legacy bodha_rm_dasha_windowed_prescriptions rows, which hold a validated non-deferrable NO ACTION foreign key onto the prescriptions table bo_upaya still deletes, so every rebuild would raise a foreign-key violation; the detector still reads PASS (register R244, v2.5).
